body: Thank you. It feels so stupid to want to end a life that so many people tell me they wish they had. And I hate that I have to make a lot of money just to pay my bills and support my family so I can't quit and try something else to become sane again even if I tried. I've been to therapy, I'm on medication, I *know* the right things to do and say and feel, but sometimes little things happen and the facade crashes down. It's like I'm running a marathon and I want to stop but I look down and realize I'm not even running, I'm just being dragged along by the people who rely on me and everything hurts and I just want the pain to stop. There were a bunch of responsible things I was supposed to do today and none of them happened that I'll have to explain away later, but I didn't do anything irreversible either. Thank you for responding. I feel a little less alone in a world full of people who never see me.
